abstract: PURPOSE: We determined the pathological findings and clinical outcome of patients with pure embryonal carcinoma (EC) of the testis managed by primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. MATERIALS AND METHODS: From January 1989 to February 1998, 45 patients with pure EC underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection at our institution. Patients presented as clinical stage I in 26, IIA in 17 and IIB in 2. Lymphovascular invasion was present in 29 (64%). Median followup was 36.8 months. RESULTS: Overall the pathological stage was pN0 in 11, pN1 in 10 (4 with microscopic disease) and pN2/N3 in 24 patients (8 with extranodal extension). Nineteen of 26 patients (73%) with clinical stage I and 13 of 17 (77%) patients with clinical stage IIA had retroperitoneal disease. No patient with negative lymph nodes (pN0) has had relapse. Only 1 of 9 (11%) patients with pN1 treated without adjuvant chemotherapy has had relapse. Of 24 patients with pN2/N3 disease only 3 (12%) have required more than 2 cycles of postoperative chemotherapy for persistent or recurrent disease despite complete resection of the retroperitoneum. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with low stage pure EC of the testis are at high risk for retroperitoneal disease. However these patients do not appear to be at increased risk for high volume (pN2/N3) retroperitoneal disease, systemic relapse in pN0 or pN1 disease managed without adjuvant chemotherapy (although the number of evaluable patients in this subset is somewhat small), or persistent or recurrent disease in completely resected high volume (pN2/N3) retroperitoneal disease compared to patients with mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣の純粋胎児性癌（EC）の患者について、一次的後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）で管理された患者の病理所見と臨床転帰を明らかにすること。対象と方法：1989年1月から1998年2月まで、当施設で45例の純粋EC患者が一次的RPLNDを受けた。臨床病期Iが26例、臨床病期IIAが17例、臨床病期IIBが2例であった。リンパ管・血管侵襲は29例（64%）に認められた。追跡期間中央値は36.8か月。結果：全体の病理病期はpN0が11例、pN1が10例（うち4例は顕微鏡的病変）、pN2/N3が24例（8例で節外浸潤）。臨床病期I 26例のうち19例（73%）、臨床病期IIA 17例のうち13例（77%）で後腹膜病変を認めた。リンパ節陰性（pN0）の患者に再発はなかった。補助化学療法なしで治療されたpN1の9例のうち1例（11%）のみ再発した。pN2/N3の24例のうち、完全切除後も持続性または再発性の病変のために術後化学療法を2サイクル超要した者は3例（12%）のみであった。結論：低病期の純粋ECの精巣腫瘍患者は後腹膜病変のリスクが高い。しかし、大量（pN2/N3）の後腹膜病変、補助化学療法なしで管理したpN0またはpN1の全身再発、完全切除された大量（pN2/N3）後腹膜病変の持続性または再発性病変のリスクは、混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者と比べて増加していない。
